findings.location: Statement, second paragraph (density-matrix trace pairing); Proof 3.1 (trace cyclicity and basis independence).
findings.evidence: The item uses Tr(ρ), Tr(ρA), and Tr(AB) before defining the trace operation, and its deps do not include a trace definition. Proof 3.1 gives a coordinate identity involving Tr but never states Tr(A)=Σ_i A_ii. The exact published definition def-trace-of-an-endomorphism supplies the finite-dimensional basis-matrix trace and its basis independence, but is absent from this item's dependency closure. Add that exact supplier and state the convention, or define trace locally before using it.

findings.location: Statement, first paragraph (logarithms on positive supports); Proof 3.1.
findings.evidence: The item defines f(M) by summing f(λ)P_λ over the full spectrum, then claims logarithms are defined “on positive supports” without defining the support subspace or the domain/convention when M has a zero eigenvalue. No listed dependency supplies this definition; def-qc-density-operator defines support only for density operators and is not in this item's deps. Define the positive spectral subspace and the logarithm there, or remove the unused claim.

findings.location: Statement, second paragraph (final “extreme points” claim); Proof 5.1.
findings.evidence: The Statement calls rank-one density matrices exactly the extreme points of the finite density-matrix set, while neither the item nor its deps defines a convex set's extreme point. Proof 5.1 uses the strict-convex-combination criterion without citing it. The exact published definition def-extreme-point-and-face supplies that criterion; add it as a prerequisite and identify the density-matrix set as the convex set, or define the criterion locally.
